title: Clarence Profit and Bobby Henderson as early influences
summary: Asked about hearing Hines and Armstrong, Ramirez says Profit and Henderson came before that and played very well when he first heard them.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone

blocks.x: Now, you told me once before that one of the first people you heard impress was Earl with Louis -- Earl Hines and Louis Armstrong.
Oh yeah. This is before this.
Well, what was Clarence Profit doing before that?
I don't know. I don't remember
I mean, how well was he playing when you first heard him? He and Bobby Henderson.
Bobby Henderson... They were playing very-very-very clearly(?)... You know, they were playing very well. But when I became around 13, 12...13 or 14, I...
